title: 34:16 book of the Lord. During the day of the Lord, those whose names are found in the book of the Lord will be delivered from the "time of trouble" (Dan. 12:1), and they will inherit the celestial city (Rev. 21:22-27). This book of the Lord may be the "book of life" identified more than a dozen times in the scriptures (Dan. 12:1; Rev. 3:5; 20:12; D&C 76:68; 128:7).
author: Tina M. Peterson
